parts.label: f
parts.text:
Replace the block and observe the images of P1 and P2 through side CD of the block from the
direction indicated by the eye in Fig. 4.1 so that the images of P1 and P2 appear one behind
the other.
Push two pins P3 and P4 into the surface, between your eye and the block, so that P3, P4 and
the images of P1 and P2, seen through the block, appear in line.
Mark the positions of P1, P2, P3 and P4. Remove the block.
